information:
**This is a twin competition with [Irvine FMC A 2022](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/IrvineFMCA2022). You may only sign up to ONE competition (A or B).**

First time competitors may compete, but please note that there is only the Fewest Moves event.

Spectators are ***not allowed*** at this competition. If you need to stay, but are not competing, you will need to wait outside the venue.

Additional details about travel, parking, etc. will be emailed to approved competitors after registration closes.
